title: Episode title card: the number line at half size, the title in heavy Mincho broken into an L (one glyph, then the rest after a half-pitch comma) on black, paper or the red card
use: Chapter, episode or section openers; the cut-in card of a film or a deck.

ground.note: black: white on black; paper: black on #F0F2F0; red: red-orange on #140202

number.note: row: the number over the title at half its size; column: set vertically down the left edge

compress.note: horizontal compression of the title lines (a line wider than the card is compressed further, never under 0.65)

scale.note: title size against the measured 31% of the card height

head_1.note: line one: one glyph (the L's upright)

relations: Left margin 6.5% of H, number ink top 6.4% of H; number ink 15.4% of H, title ink 31% of H (2:1).
Line one ink top at 26.4% of H, line two at 60.5% of H; the comma advances half a glyph.
The type block weighs to the lower left; the right tenth of the card stays empty.
decoration: Nothing: a title card carries no decoration.

provenance.corpus: tidemark case (潮位警报 TIDEMARK): our own original organisation terminal site, two app screens and UI kit in the crisis-command grammar
provenance.experiment: styles/crisis-command/style.json provenance (reference frames measured privately; never shipped)
provenance.method: glyph ink boxes on the 2048 x 1536 reference card (number 240 x 237, title 483 x 474, comma 154 wide, lines at 405 and 930), composition share and weight centre
measured: Case: 第壹报 水 / 位、越线 at 0 findings.
